name: Sint Maarten
summary: Red over blue with a white triangle at the hoist bearing the coat of arms: a courthouse in an orange-bordered shield, under a rising sun with a brown pelican, and the motto 'Semper pro grediens'.
origin: The flag was adopted on 13 June 1985 for the island territory of Sint Maarten, the Dutch part of the island of Saint Martin. It became a constituent country of the Kingdom in 2010.

symbols.name: Courthouse
symbols.description: The Philipsburg courthouse on the shield.

symbols.name: Pelican and sun
symbols.description: A brown pelican flying across a rising sun.
symbols.meaning: The national bird and a bright future.

facts: The island is split between Sint Maarten (Dutch) and Saint-Martin (French).
Its layout resembles the Philippine flag.
Its border monument commemorates the 1648 Treaty of Concordia dividing the island.
clues: Red over blue with a white hoist triangle holding a shield with a courthouse and a pelican.
Its island is shared with a French territory.
